source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: FilterCopyCompleted adds MOZ_ASSERT(m_filterCopyState) and MOZ_ASSERT(m_filterCopyState->mPendingCopies > 0) without message arguments. Add nonempty messages stating that copy state should exist and the pending-copy count should be positive before completion decrements it. The following null guard is real behavior, while the assertions are diagnostics; this finding does not claim an observed release crash or counter failure. The new JavaScript test assertions already have nonempty expected-behavior messages.
title: The new IMAP copy-state assertions omit their expected-state messages
